title: Hold a route service licence for a declared air route
what: Operate a scheduled passenger air service on a route the Minister has declared only while holding a route service licence for that route.

sources.title: Air Transport (Route Licensing—Passenger Services) Act 2002 (SA)
sources.publisher: South Australian Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not, during the period of a declaration under Part 2, operate a scheduled air service on the declared route unless the person is the holder of a route service licence for that route issued by the Minister under this Act

marks.reason: A route service licence limits who may fly a declared route.

Conditions, records and fees add ongoing cost.
